_README: Human / Planning-Board decisions that OVERRIDE the auto-classification. Keyed by segment id (see work/review.csv). Each entry may set any of: type (S1-S5/R1-R5), ownership, row_ft, traveled_ft, nonconformity, note. These are version-controlled and merged on every pipeline re-run, so adopted decisions survive data refreshes. Example: "main-street-1": { "type": "S1", "nonconformity": "ROW 38 ft, narrower than Type" }
